headline: Manchester City 55.7% away favourites at Aston Villa
summary: Manchester City are clear favourites at Aston Villa in Saturday's Premier League game, 55.7% to win. The market rates City about three-quarters of a goal better than Villa, a handicap line of 0.77. The draw is 22.6%, rated above a Villa win at 21.6%, so a tight Villa Park is seen as more likely than a home victory. Goals are the other part of the picture: the total is 3.09, Over 3.0 has moved from 50.3% to 52.2%, and both teams to score is 60.5%. An open, high-scoring game with City on top.
